name: Bot Foundry
tagline: Describe an idea or a daily chore and get a full draft bot package, ready to publish
description: Feed it a single idea, or a chore you keep repeating every day, and it drafts the entire bot around it: the concept, a quick market scan, the persona, the skills, the routines and even a test plan. It will write candidate launch posts too, so the announcement is not a blank page. The publish button stays in your hand.
author: BTC_Yogi
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
